label: preparing
what: A possible bridge or port alteration at the bakery is being coordinated. Townsfolk report the named group was present, and there is suggestive associated stock (hay blocks and emeralds), but whether an alteration is actually underway is unconfirmed; the baker denies witnessing one. The mayor-neighbour town-hall visit is explicitly ordinary and needs no preparation, so it is not evidence of a concealed plan. The secretary is investigating rather than knowingly helping the alteration; evidence does not establish their involvement or the specific purpose/details of the change.
